statusLine.command: bash -c 'S="$WSROOT/.claude/scripts/statusline.py"; test -f "$S" || { echo "claude-hook[statusline]: $S not found, skipping" >&2; exit 0; }; R="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/statusline/runner"; if read -r M P < "$R" 2>/dev/null; then SM=$(stat -c %Y "$S" 2>/dev/null || stat -f %m "$S" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$SM" ] && [ "$M" = "$SM" ] && [ -x "$P" ]; then exec "$P" "$S"; fi; fi; exec uv run --script "$S"'
